description: This file contains CKEditor 5 plugin code for text highlighting, including translation dictionaries, style definitions, plugin classes, and UI components.

classes.name: Highlight
classes.description: Main CKEditor plugin class for text highlighting, integrating UI and editing functionalities.

classes.name: HighlightCommand
classes.description: Command class to execute and manage highlight attribute in editor.

classes.name: HighlightEditing
classes.description: Plugin class managing the editing behavior for highlight attribute.

classes.name: HighlightUI
classes.description: UI plugin class providing toolbar buttons and dropdowns for highlight options.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the highlight command state based on current selection.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the highlight command with specified value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up schema, conversion, commands, and UI components.

methods.name: _addRemoveHighlightButton
methods.description: Adds a button to remove highlight.

methods.name: _addHighlighterButton
methods.description: Adds a button for a specific highlight type.

methods.name: _addDropdown
methods.description: Creates and adds the highlight options dropdown menu.

methods.name: _addMenuBarButton
methods.description: Adds highlight options to the menu bar.
